manifest.longDescription:
Bring your Ambilight experience to the next level.

HyperHDR for LG webOS lets you control your lighting setup directly from your TV – no additional devices required. Enjoy seamless integration and adjust your lighting in real time, right from your couch.

KEY FEATURES
• Direct connection to your HyperHDR server
• Real-time control of Ambilight effects
• Adjust brightness, colors and effects
• Fast, lightweight and TV-optimized UI

REQUIREMENTS
• A running HyperHDR instance in your network
• LG webOS TV with Homebrew Channel
• Root access may be required depending on your setup

Learn more:
https://github.com/satgit62/webos-hyperhdr
